question: ________ is NOT part of the Union Executive.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Supreme Court of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Executive of India includes the **President**, the **Vice-President**, the **Prime Minister**, and the **Council of Ministers**.
 
• The **Union Executive **is responsible for the **enforcement of laws **and the administration of the country.
 
• The **Supreme Court of India**, on the other hand, is the **apex judicial authority **in the country and is part of the Judiciary, not the Executive.
 
• The President of India is the head of the Union Executive and is elected by an electoral college.
 
• The Prime Minister leads the Council of Ministers, which aids and advises the President in the exercise of their functions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Union Executive** is one of the three branches of the government of India, the other two being the Legislature and the Judiciary.
 
• The **Supreme Court** is responsible for interpreting the Constitution and adjudicating disputes between the central government and the states, among other duties.
 
• The Union Executive operates under the framework of the Constitution of India, which came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• The Constitution of India establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
